notes: Adds a default-off Include release candidates checkbox to the Application Update UI.
Allows support-guided online checks to resolve the release_candidate target from releases/latest.json.
Keeps normal online updates on the stable release channel by default.
Keeps update apply behavior pinned to the confirmed release tag.
Adds release-candidate warnings to update details and confirmation messaging.
Does not change firmware, device protocol, motion, pressure control, offline update behavior, or rollback behavior.
summary: Adds a controlled release-candidate toggle for support-guided app update testing.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
